slot.brief: Give ΔH (or ΔU) for a reaction involving gaseous species and ask for ΔU (or ΔH) using ΔH = ΔU + Δng RT; one-step computation with R = 8.314.

stem: For the reaction $\text{PCl}_5(g) \rightarrow \text{PCl}_3(g) + \text{Cl}_2(g)$, $\Delta U = 87.0000\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$ at $300\ \text{K}$. Find $\Delta H$. Take $R = 8.314\ \text{J K}^{-1}\text{mol}^{-1}$.

verdicts.working: For ideal gases, ΔH = ΔU + Δn_gRT. Here Δn_g = 2 − 1 = 1, so ΔH = 87.0000 + (8.314 × 300)/1000 = 89.4942 kJ mol⁻¹.

working:
$\Delta n_g = 2 - 1 = 1$
$\Delta H = \Delta U + \Delta n_gRT$
$=87.0000 + \dfrac{(1)(8.314)(300)}{1000}$
$=89.4942\ \text{kJ mol}^{-1}$

Independent check: For ideal gases, ΔH = ΔU + Δn_gRT. Here Δn_g = 2 − 1 = 1, so ΔH = 87.0000 + (8.314 × 300)/1000 = 89.4942 kJ mol⁻¹.
